title: Endpoint Sobolev regularity of centered disk averages

result.label: Endpoint Sobolev regularity of centered disk averages
result.statement: Resolves the planar centered-disk case of the Hajłasz–Onninen maximal-function regularity problem. For every real f W^ 1,1 ( R^2), the centered disk maximal function satisfies | Mf |1 C | f |1 with an absolute constant. It belongs locally to W^ 1,1 and has a globally integrable weak gradient.
